scene_description: Two young children stand in a puddle on a dirt path surrounded by green trees. The girl on the left wears pink rain boots and holds a clear umbrella. The boy on the right wears yellow rain boots and holds a rainbow-colored umbrella. Both children wear colorful jackets.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people standing in the puddle.
